title: Docker Hub limits are irrelevant to a self-hosted registry

canonical_premises.statement: Production image pulls must stay on the private network through the self-hosted registry.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: Production image pulls must remain on the private network.

canonical_premises.statement: The self-hosted registry has enough capacity for production image pulls.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: The self-hosted registry has enough storage and network capacity for production pulls.
